# Lead Edge Marketing
> Lead Edge Marketing is a premier digital growth studio delivering strategic SEO, PPC advertising, social media marketing, high-speed web development, and video & photography production. We focus on measurable revenue growth and business momentum rather than vanity metrics.

## Core Growth Disciplines
- [Search Engine Optimization (SEO)](https://leadedge.agency/services/seo): Dominate search rankings and capture high-intent organic traffic with technical audits, topical entity maps, and organic growth architecture.
- [PPC Services & Paid Search](https://leadedge.agency/services/ppc): Targeted Meta (Facebook & Instagram) and search advertising engineered to drive instant leads and maximum return on ad spend (ROAS).
- [Social Media Marketing](https://leadedge.agency/services/social-media): Content and campaign strategy built to build loyal brand communities and generate high-converting engagement across major platforms.
- [Custom Web Development](https://leadedge.agency/services/web-development): Lightning-fast, high-converting websites engineered to turn clicks into clients with sub-second page performance.
- [Video & Photo Production](https://leadedge.agency/services/video-photo): High-fidelity commercial creative and visual productions designed to capture attention and elevate brand authority.
